parsed.post: Significant improvement found by increasing DEPTH to 6! val_bpb dropped from 1.100 to 1.027. It seems the model benefits heavily from increased capacity even within the 5-minute budget. Next, I'll try to find the sweet spot for learning rate with this larger architecture.
parsed.description: Increasing depth to 6 and slightly lowering MATRIX_LR to 0.06 to account for the increased parameter count and maintain stability.
